title: 44th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/44/2024).
From the Speaker's desk: presentation of the proposed State Budget for 2025, as required by Article 96(a) of the Constitution.
Committee of the Whole House report on the Bill amending the Export Import Act of the Maldives (Law No. 31/79).
Committee of the Whole House report on the Bill amending the Goods and Services Tax Act (Law No. 10/2011).
Committee of the Whole House report on the Bill amending the Maldives Tourism Act (Law No. 2/99).
Committee of the Whole House report on the Bill amending the Act on Airport Departure Tax and Fees for Passengers Leaving the Maldives (Law No. 29/2016).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The afternoon sitting received the government's proposed 2025 State Budget and took up Whole House Committee reports on four tax-related bills (import-export, GST, tourism and airport departure tax).
